review_scope: All60 input images inspected; VP037 also at native resolution. This is input analysis, not generated-video acceptance.
interpretation: Input issues and learned model failures coexist. Missing participants or an advanced initial state do not by themselves prove impossibility. Preserve every official case, and evaluate model gains on both flagged and unflagged inputs without changing headline aggregates.
